# CDN scripts and styles need an integrity hash (SRI).
# Ok blocks come first: the no-integrity pattern spans forward otherwise.
# ok: use-SRI-for-CDNs
<script src="https://cdn.example.com/a.js" integrity="sha384-aaa111">
</script>
# ok: use-SRI-for-CDNs
<link href="https://cdn.example.com/a.css" integrity="sha384-bbb222">
# ruleid: use-SRI-for-CDNs
<script src="https://cdn.example.com/b.js">
</script>
# ruleid: use-SRI-for-CDNs
<link href="https://cdn.example.com/b.css">
